normalization: Originals as fetched under original/, pinned to a commit of the repository named in origin.items. text/<slug>.txt is the TEI reduced to plain text by seat.py (rebuild/corpora/ea-corpora-27), notes and apparatus dropped, divisions kept. No text was corrected by hand.
scope: The four books of epinicians entire. The fragments (paeans, dithyrambs, partheneia, threnoi) are not in the Perseus files; they are queued to Bergk's Poetae Lyrici Graeci, 4th edition, vol. I (1878).
verified_loci: Ol. 1.1, the opening of the first ode — 'ἄριστον μὲν ὕδωρ, ὁ δὲ χρυσὸς αἰθόμενον πῦρ'
Pyth. 8.95–96, the dream of a shadow — 'σκιᾶς ὄναρ'
why_seated: Pindar is the ninth of the nine lyric poets and the only one whose books survive; the seat carries the canon whose other members survive in fragments.
